quest.title: At Least the Fish Know
quest.description: The journalist Linorea seems troubled by something...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go check out the deep waters.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you. Unfortunately, given the state of my divesuit... that's all I can do right now.

talks.objective: Go to the deep waters to place the fish fry

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: The number of fish in here has decreased again. Are the Mekafish acting up again?

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: I need to put the fry out into deeper waters... Ugh, why did my divesuit have to give out now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you up to?

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Hello there. Pleased to meet you. I'm Linorea, a journalist specializing in reporting on environmental issues. I'm... putting fish fry into these waters.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you look familiar. Weren't you with Semaine when we last saw him, Linorea?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You must be Semaine's...

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Wait, you know Semaine? Are you... Oh, were you the ones who helped him bring those gifts? Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Semaine only told me about that after I'd finished watching the opera and returned home previously. Honestly, I've been looking to invite you for a meal at my place.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: I didn't think I would meet you here... but this is really bad timing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You just said that you're throwing fry into the water, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And why are you doing that, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Do you know about Mekafish?

choices.text: Are they a species unique to the Court of Fontaine?

talks.objective: Go to the shallow waters to place the fish fry
Go to the shallow waters to place the fish fry

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Have you helped me place the fry into the water? Given the state of my divesuit, I can only count on you at the moment.

talks.objective: Go to the shallow waters to place the fish fry

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Have you helped me place the fry into the water?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Thanks so much. Once I fix my divesuit, I'll come back and continue my work.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope those fish will grow up safely.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I've prepared many species of fry for all sorts of waters and different environments.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: The batch that you placed earlier was chosen specifically for this region.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: I'll place a few more batches, and then the adventurers we hired will come over and clear out the Mekafish in the area.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: I believe that this batch will grow up healthy and restore the ecological environment in this area.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Once enough water bodies have recovered, I'll write a long-form report. I'll tell the public what the Fontaine Research Institute has done to our natural environment.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Just you wait, Damestier. I won't let you stop me again!

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: The number of fish in here has decreased again. Are the Mekafish acting up again?

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: I need to put the fry out into deeper waters... Ugh, why did my divesuit have to give out now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you up to?

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Hello there. Pleased to meet you. I'm Linorea, a journalist specializing in reporting on environmental issues. I'm... putting fish fry into these waters.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: That's right, the sort you know of. But I'm not like those who publish gossip about public figures or regurgitate boring news all day.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: What I'm concerned about is an ongoing, serious issue that threatens the safety of the general public here in the Court of Fontaine.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: And that is why I am here putting fry out into the waters.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: Do you know about Mekafish?

choices.text: Are they a species unique to the Court of Fontaine?
And why are you doing that, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll check out the shallow waters.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you. Unfortunately, given the state of my divesuit... that's all I can do right now.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Hmph. These Mekafish are clockwork machines created by the Fontaine Research Institute. They're the ones ruining the waters in the Court of Fontaine!

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: A water body usually has a balanced ecosystem where various fish and other creatures live together within a stable order. This order allows them to grow and thrive.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Even though this order is sometimes disrupted when, say, people come to fish, when invasive species are introduced...

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Sometimes, the weather also shifts, causing some fish to leave these waters...

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: There is a subtle balance being maintained within this water body, on the whole.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: But everything turned into a complete mess ever since those idiots at the Institute created the Mekafish!

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: They promote them as tools that can keep the waters clean by removing trash and other assorted items in the water. Nothing else, they say!

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: And at first, that is what they did, and we believed the nonsense they fed us.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: But after a while, we received reports that fish populations were constantly decreasing in water bodies where Mekafish were deployed.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: That's when we realized that the Mekafish labeled other fish as "trash" when doing their cleanup work!

choices.text: So that's how they define "clean water"...

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: Faced with intense resistance from us, those researchers deactivated the Mekafish and prepared for their retrieval.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: But as they were preparing to do so, there was a huge explosion at the Institute...

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: After that, some of those originally deactivated Mekafish reactivated themselves, and began attacking fish even more fiercely.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: Several of my colleagues and I agreed that this could not go on. If the Mekafish are left to run amok, they will bring calamity upon our aquatic ecosystem!

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: So, with the help of several environmentalists, we planned to place suitable fish fry in various water bodies and cultivate new batches of fish through artificial means.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: On the other hand, we hired adventurers to constantly destroy and retrieve Mekafish, thus forming a two-pronged approach to protecting the ecology of our waters.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: Thank you for your praise — I know this doesn't sound like something a journalist should be doing.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: However, I believe that our duty to go to the frontline and do some practical work comes before writing essays and articles.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: Only by doing frontline work can we obtain the truest and most accurate information, with which the best report can be written.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, this reporter's really impressive...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What can I do to help?

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: Hmm? Well, thanks for your kind offer. My divesuit is currently non-functional, so I can't go underwater to distribute fish fry.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: If you don't mind, could you go down and do it for me? Shallow or deep zones, doesn't matter.

choices.text: Everything that's not water is considered trash...

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: These Mekafish... What a pain!

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: I did, but it fell apart quite quickly afterward.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: The Mekafish in this area have gone hog-wild, for... whatever reason.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: No sooner did I try to place the fish fry in their vicinity that they swarmed over, gobbling the fry up non-stop.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: Some of them even lunged at me to get the few fry hanging off my divesuit...

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: I mean, I know they won't attack me... But that was still terrifying.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: I struggled, flailing in the water...

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: I don't know how, but that tore another large hole in my divesuit somewhere... Fortunately, I was close enough to the shore that getting back up ultimately proved possible.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: As things stand, however, I won't be able to distribute the fry for the time being.

response.speaker: Linorea
response.text: Traveler, could you help me do it once again? Shallow or deep zones, doesn't matter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That should do it. Let's go back and look for Linorea!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That should do it. Let's go back and look for Linorea!
